text: Delivered in merge 623d5ba (branch commits f39c6ce, 4d0407e) on top of Codex's pl-detect tranche 08b251b. kernel MachineCursor/MachinePage (pure chunked Machine driver, flush exactly once, law-tested against runAll with double-flush and dropped-emission mutants); detect DetectionCursor with Detection.execute cursor-driven and single-scan emission checks; design SampleQuantum on WorkQuanta; plan Stepwise typeclass, RecordingCursor (RecordingPlan.run = work driven to completion, same computations and error order), PreparedTemporalStudy/TemporalCursor (all repetitions prepared before any cell); fs2 generic Execution (X4 body moved verbatim) with StudyExecution as a source-compatible wrapper, RecordingExecution (Exact totals), TemporalExecution (per-cell segments). 28 new tests incl. barrier cancellation in preprocessing/detection/occupancy/between cells, parity with plan.run at every quantum, the R-pinned temporal fixture at 1e-12, composition of a temporal run from its cells. Fresh-context review: merge after fixes, all applied. Verified on merged main: root 2,545 (one 30 s streaming timeout under three concurrent sbt JVMs; suite passes 6/6 in isolation), consumer green. Admitted difference: a later repetition's preparation error is reported before an earlier repetition's execution error; cannot alter a successful result. Left for X6: Stepwise/Execution laws with mutants, responsiveness measurement, run-level totals.
